FN-R5S4MM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 106
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Government
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/10/2023
House Bill 106 as introduced could decrease expenditures of county and municipal governments
by an undetermined amount dependent on the advertising costs otherwise incurred to publish
certain legal notices in a newspaper. This bill would not directly affect state funding.
